label: fix-fence

fixes.mechanism: write-once outcome log wt/T-eE/outcome/<j>.json; the child's hook test-and-sets a ready slot from the Write tool's content (lock-free exclusive create); replace fence, in its lock hold, refuses on an uncommitted ready slot, else appends a fenced slot before the CAS

fixes.mechanism: claim.json per attempt by exclusive create: the session id at the child's first tool call, or a tombstone written by fence; reconcile reads the claim; stop verify confirms only on a tombstone or a recorded close; slotCount counts unclaimed or unclosed folder sessions; start lease leads to an uncharged fence

fixes.depends: Q5: (a) as designed; (b) no session tools, no run possible, the gate still covers plan/ and helpers

fixes.mechanism: act-due for a committed row that is not closed; stop request accepts committed/started; verify needs close_issued; a lease is rejected (a session never stops itself)

handed_to_wake_group: dead lock holder while the process list is unavailable: liveness only here; a lease break stays safe because writeTasks and appendLedger re-check the nonce before writing; FX-OUT and FX-CLAIM are lock-free
